All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AudioChannel
A server-side audio source that streams sound to players through the voice relay: music, sound effects, recordings, radio stations and so on.
AudioPlayer
Feeds an AudioChannel with one frame every 20 ms on a background thread.
ClientLocalVoiceStateEvent
The local player's microphone mute or deafen state was published (hotkey, settings screen or API).
ClientMicrophoneEvent
The local microphone produced a frame that is about to be encoded and sent to the server.
ClientReceiveAudioEvent
A frame of incoming audio was decoded and is about to be mixed into the output.
ClientTalkingStateEvent
A player started or stopped talking, as heard by the local client (includes the local player).
ClientVoiceApi
Client-side Cozy Voice Chat API for the local player, from CozyVoiceApi.get().client().
ClientVoiceConnectionEvent
The local voice connection status changed.
ClientVoiceSettingsChangedEvent
The local voice settings were changed and saved (devices, mode, volumes, player volumes...).
CozyVoiceApi
Entry point of the Cozy Voice Chat addon API.
EntityAudioChannel
Audio that follows an entity (a talking mob, a boombox carried by a player, a minecart radio).
LocationalAudioChannel
Audio coming from a fixed point in a level (speakers, jukeboxes, alarms).
MicrophonePacketEvent
The server received one voice frame (20 ms of Opus audio) from a player.
ServerVoiceApi
Server-side Cozy Voice Chat API, from CozyVoiceApi.get().server().
StaticAudioChannel
Audio without a position, played "in the head" of the chosen listeners at full volume (phone calls, announcements, background music).
VoiceAudioFormat
Audio format used everywhere in Cozy Voice Chat: 48 kHz, mono, signed 16-bit PCM, in frames of 20 ms (960 samples).
VoiceCategory
Audio categories carried with every voice frame.
VoiceConnectionEvent
A player's voice connection on the server opened or closed.
VoiceConnectionEvent.Connected
The client finished the UDP handshake; the player can now talk and listen.
VoiceConnectionEvent.Disconnected
The player's voice session ended.
VoiceConnectionEvent.Disconnected.Reason
Why the session ended.
VoiceConnectionStatus
State of the local client's voice connection.
VoiceDecoder
Opus decoder producing VoiceAudioFormat frames.
VoiceEffect
Built-in server-side voice effects.
VoiceEncoder
Opus encoder for VoiceAudioFormat frames.
VoiceGroup
A voice group: members hear each other at full volume regardless of distance or level (as VoiceCategory.GLOBAL).
VoiceMuteChangedEvent
A player was muted or unmuted (by /cozyvoice mute|unmute or the API).
VoiceRouteEvent
A route (the list of listeners) was computed for a talking player.
VoiceRouteHook
Server-side extension point for voice routing (radios, global microphones, custom mutes...).
VoiceRouteHook.Sink
Receives the recipients of a route.
VoiceStateChangedEvent
A player turned their microphone off/on or deafened/undeafened themselves on their client.
VoiceTarget
One recipient of a player's voice, as used by MicrophonePacketEvent.getTargets() and VoiceRouteEvent.getTargets().
